tagline: Instant seblak in Original Kencur and Keju Creamy variants, built for retail and export-market conversations.

story.title: Instant seblak in Original Kencur and Keju Creamy variants, built for retail and export-market conversations.
story.body: Rumah Kurasi and InaExport both publish Seblak Instan Lalisha Food from Setu. The product is available as Original Kencur and Keju Creamy, requires only hot-water preparation, and has public P-IRT and Halal documentation. InaExport lists a monthly capacity of 10,000 packs and minimum order of 100 packs.
